source_refs.note: 14.16.3 Political Issues: a main subheading of 14.16 Economic, social and political issues, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 319-319.

items: Implementing effective air quality regulations can be challenging due to political and economic interests.
Air pollution is not confined to borders and effective management requires international corporation.
Implementing air quality regulations requires strict governance, which might slow down industrial growth and economic development and leads to political conflicts.
Addressing air pollution requires a multi-faceted approach, balancing socio-economic, and technological considerations.
